description: This file contains utility functions for geometric transformations used in image augmentation, including functions to create rotation, translation, shear, scaling, flip, and combined random transformations, as well as applying transformations to axis-aligned bounding boxes.

methods.name: colvec
methods.description: Creates a numpy array representing a column vector from input arguments.

methods.name: transform_aabb
methods.description: Applies a geometric transformation to an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) and returns the transformed AABB.

methods.name: rotation
methods.description: Constructs a 2D rotation matrix for a given angle in radians.

methods.name: random_rotation
methods.description: Generates a random 2D rotation matrix with an angle uniformly sampled between min and max.

methods.name: translation
methods.description: Constructs a 2D translation matrix for a given translation vector.

methods.name: random_translation
methods.description: Generates a random translation matrix with translation vector components sampled between min and max.

methods.name: shear
methods.description: Constructs a 2D shear matrix for a given shear angle.

methods.name: random_shear
methods.description: Generates a random shear matrix with shear angle sampled between min and max.

methods.name: scaling
methods.description: Constructs a 2D scaling matrix for given scale factors.

methods.name: random_scaling
methods.description: Generates a random scaling matrix with scale factors sampled between min and max.

methods.name: random_flip
methods.description: Creates a transformation matrix that randomly flips along X and Y axes based on specified chances.

methods.name: change_transform_origin
methods.description: Adjusts a transformation matrix to change its origin to a specified point.

methods.name: random_transform
methods.description: Creates a composite random transformation matrix including rotation, translation, shear, scaling, and flips.

methods.name: random_transform_generator
methods.description: Creates a generator that yields random transformation matrices with specified parameters.
